name: Befuddle Bugs
summary:
Befuddle Bugs turns your real room into a living mixed-reality creature habitat. Start with a few tiny bug friends and build a colony that eats, sleeps, plays, socializes, breeds, gets scared, gets happy, and develops a life of its own around you.
